content: Huriyutsixi kememɨte'ayu'iwaxɨ

Ti'aitame xapaya kaniuye'axɨanikekaitɨni tamamata heimana haika tukari, tamamata heimana huta metseriyaritsie, 'araxi metseriyari mɨhɨkɨ. Huriyutsixi memɨwaraye'unie mekanitakwewiekaitɨni mɨkɨ tukaritsie memɨwakwinikɨ, peru xapate kaniuyupataxɨani huriyutsixi mekateniwa'aitɨakaitɨni kemɨ'ane memɨwakwikukai.
'Atsuheru mɨra'aita memɨte'awiya, huriyutsixi mekaniyuxeɨriekaitɨni yukiekaritsie memɨwatakwinikɨ 'iya memɨwaraye'uniekai. Nixewitɨ mɨwatakwinikɨ pɨkayuwaɨriyakai yunaitɨ mepɨmamakai.
Yunaitɨ naitsarie kwieyaritsie te'uximayatamete meta ti'aitame parewiwamete, kuwexinaruritsixi, huriyutsixi mekaniwaparewiekaitɨni, Maxirukeyu memakatɨ.
Maxirukeyu 'aixɨa tiyurienetɨ kanayuyeitɨani paratsiyuta. Nikuxaxatsiwakaitɨni naitsarie kwiepa waɨkawa mariwetɨ kanayeiximekaitɨni.
Huriyutsixi 'ixiparakɨ mekaniwarukwini yunaime memɨwaraye'uniekai. Mekaniwarakumaweriya, yamekateniuyurieni kemɨtiwanake memɨwaxani'eriekai wahetsiemieme.
Tsutsa kiekariteyaritsie 'auxɨwime tsienituyari teɨteri mekaniwarukwini.
Meta mekaniukwi'iwa Paritsanirata, Raripuni, 'Atsipata,
Purata, 'Arariyaxi, 'Arirata,
Parimatsita, 'Aritsai, 'Arirahi, meta Wahitsata,
tamamata memɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'Amani niwemama Hamerata nu'aya, huriyutsixi memɨwaraye'uniekai. Peru piiniteya mepɨkatehepi.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie ti'aitame retimaika keyupaɨmetɨ memukwi'iwaxɨ Tsutsa kiekariteyaritsie,

'uka ti'aitame 'Etsitexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Huriyutsixi 'auxɨwime tsienituyari memɨwarukwi, meta tamamata 'Amani niwemama Tsutsa kiekariyaritsie, matsi kiekari mamanetɨkatsie kememɨteheyurie. Kenetineutaxatɨa titapereuyehɨwa, yanepɨtikayani. ¿Tita tawarita pereuyehɨwa? Yapɨtiyɨni kepemɨtayɨni.

'Etsitexi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ti'aitame xɨka matsinakeni, huriyutsixi Tsutsa kiekatari keniwarupitɨa 'uxa'ake memɨtetahayewakɨ hikɨ mieme kepemɨtiwarupitɨa, meta keniwarupitɨa tamamata 'Amani niwemama kɨyexitsie memɨkaxuiyaxɨanikɨ.
Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aita. Tsutsa kiekariyaritsie xapa kaniyetuiyani, tamamata me'aye'ukame 'Amani niwemama kɨyexitsie memɨkaxuiyaxɨanikɨ.
Huriyutsixi Tsutsa kiekatari mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni tamamata heimana nauka tukariyaritsie, 'araxi metseriyaritsie, 'ana mekaniwarukwini haika tsienituyari teɨteri, peru wapiinite mepɨkatehepi.

Metatsiere, huriyutsixi kwie mamanetɨkatsie ti'aitame mɨra'aitatsie mekaniuyukuxeɨriexɨani yuhetsie memɨtanuanikɨ memɨwaraye'unie wahepaɨtsita. Haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari memɨwaxani'eriekai mekaniwarukwini, mɨkɨta wapiinite mepɨkatehetɨ.
Mɨkɨ katiniuyɨni tamamata heimana haika tukariyaritsie 'araxi metseriyaritsie. Tamamata heimana nauka tukariyaritsie mekaniuka'uxipieni, 'ixɨarari mekaniuwewieni.
Purimi kememɨte'utiwewiwanikekai
Huriyutsixi Tsutsa kiekatari tamamata heimana haika tukaritsie memuyuxeɨri meta tamamata heimana nauka, tamamata heimana 'auxɨwiriekatsie mekaniuka'uxipieni, 'ixɨarari mekaniuwewieni meyutemamawietɨ.

'Ayumieme huriyutsixi naitsarie kiekaritsie memeutitekai kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeutsie, 'ixɨarari mekaniutiwewiwakaitɨni tamamata heimana nauka tukaritsie 'araxi metseriyaritsie, temawierika tukariyari meta 'ixɨarari tukari, 'ana yunaitɨ mekateniyutamikwakaitɨni.
Hikɨ Maxirukeyu 'ikɨ naime raka'utɨaka kemɨtiuyɨ, xapate kaneutanɨ'axɨani yunaime huriyutsixi wahetsɨa, 'ateewa paitɨ memetitekai wahetsɨa meta 'ahurawa mɨtiuyehanetsie 'Atsuheru mɨra'aitakaitsie,
mɨpaɨ tiwa'aitɨatɨ xeiwiyari 'anuyeyeikakaku memitiwewiwanikɨ 'ixɨarari tamamata heimana nauka tukaritsie meta 'auxɨwirieka tukariyaritsie 'araxi metseriyaritsie,

'ana memuxɨnariekɨ huriyutsixi hipatɨ mewaraye'uniekaku kepauka wahiwerika temawierika matɨa, kepauka meta wakukwiniya temawierika 'ixɨarariyari patɨa. 'Ayumieme peuyewekai memitiwewiwanikɨ temawierika tukariyari meta 'ixɨarari, yu'ikwai meta hipame metewatamikwatɨ, tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya metewakumikwatɨ.
Mɨpaɨ huriyutsixi meteku'eriwatɨ yuyeiyari mekanayeitɨani 'ixɨarari me'utiwewiwatɨ mekanakɨne, Maxirukeyu kemɨtiwaraka'utsiriekai mete'aye'atɨwatɨ mepakɨ.

'Amani Hamerata nu'aya, 'Akaki nuiwarieya, huriyutsixi mɨwaraye'unie, naime mɨkɨ katiniuyuriekaitɨni huriyutsixi memɨkwi'iwakɨ puri kaniuwewiekaitɨni wahetsiemieme, —tatsɨari kemɨ'ane mɨrayu'iwa— mɨwahɨxiyatsitɨanikɨ mɨwakwinikɨ.

Peru kepauka 'Etsitexi ti'aitame hɨxie mutaniu, mɨkɨ xapatsie mɨpaɨ katiniu'aita kename 'Amani kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ huriyutsixi wahetsiemieme hetsiena tinakekekai, mɨkɨ meta niwemama kɨyetsie mekekaxuiyaxɨanike.
Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku mɨkɨ tukaritsie katiniuterɨwarieni Purimi, puri hetsie 'ayehaniekame. Kemɨreku'uxa xapatsie, kememɨte'unenierixɨ kememɨte'anuyekɨ,
hikɨ huriyutsixi mekaniuyu'enieni yuhetsiemieme meta yuniwema wahetsiemieme, para yunaitɨ meyuxewitɨ memitiwewiwanikɨ xeiwiyari 'anuyeyeikakaku memɨkatehayewanikɨ, kemɨreuku'uxa mɨkɨ tukaritsie.

Para yunaitɨ nuiwarite meta naitsarie kwieyaritetsie meta yunaitɨ teɨteri kiekaritetsie, memaye'eriwanikɨ memitiwewiwanikɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie xeiwiyari 'anuyeyeikakaku. Mɨkɨ Purimi tukariyari huriyutsixi yamepɨte'itiwewiwanikekai, memɨkaheiyehɨpanikɨ meta waxiɨyarima.
'Uka ti'aitame 'Etsitexi 'Awikahiri niweya, huriyu tewiyari Maxirukeyu matɨa, mekatenaka'utɨani meteha'aitatɨ hutarieka xapa Purimi hetsiemieme.
Mɨkɨ xapa kaneutanɨ'axɨani yunaime huriyutsixi wahetsɨa xeitsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana 'atahuta kwieyaritsie, 'Atsuheru pɨtiwa'aitɨakai 'aixɨa 'anekamekɨ meta yurikɨ haitɨ,

Purimi 'ixɨarariyari mematinenetɨwanikɨ kemɨ'ane tukariyaritsie, kememaitɨkatei huriyu tewiyari Maxirukeyu 'uka ti'aitame 'Etsitexi matɨa, kememɨtekuxatakai yuhetsiemieme meta yuniwema wahetsiemieme, memɨyuhakiekaitsie memuyuhiweriekaitsie meta.
Kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ 'Etsitexi Purimi hetsiemieme, mɨpaɨ katinaka'utɨarieni xapatsie.
